header: Requesting a dataset that is not in the portal
lead: Everything from 2013 onwards is downloadable without asking. Sediment cores, laboratory sheets and the pre-2013 paper records are not, and this is how you get at them.

steps.title: Check the portal first
steps.text: Roughly half the requests we receive are for series that are already published under a name the requester did not recognise. The station index lists every alternative name we have used.

steps.title: Write to the data desk
steps.text: One email with what you need, the period it covers and what you intend to do with it. The last part is not a gate — it tells us which format will save you a week.

steps.title: Wait two working days
steps.text: Straightforward requests are answered with a link. Anything requiring laboratory time gets a date instead, and the date is usually four to six weeks out.

steps.title: Credit the series
steps.text: The identifier travels with every export. Cite it rather than the institute alone, so that anyone reading your work can pull the same numbers.
